The following text is for questions number 21 to 25. The Greedy Dog One day, a hungry dog found a large, juicy bone. He was very happy and carried it in his mouth to eat it in a quiet place. On his way home, he had to cross a wooden bridge over a clear river. As he was crossing, he looked down and saw his own reflection in the water. Thinking it was another dog with a bigger bone, he became greedy. He wanted that bone too. He fiercely opened his mouth to bark at the "other dog" and snatch the bone. But the moment he opened his mouth, his own bone fell into the river and was swept away by the current. The dog was left with nothing but a hungry stomach.

21. What made the dog stop on the bridge?
pilihan_jawaban: A. He was too tired to carry the large bone.
B. He saw his own reflection in the water.
C. He wanted to drink the clear river water.
D. He saw a real dog swimming in the river.

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan: Why did the dog open his mouth?
pilihan_jawaban: A. He wanted to eat the bone right there.
B. He was surprised by the cold wind.
C. He wanted to bark and snatch the "other dog's" bone.
D. He wanted to ask for help from the other dog.

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan: Based on the story, what was the main reason for the dog's failure to eat the bone?
pilihan_jawaban: A. The bridge was too slippery and dangerous.
B. The river current was too strong.
C. Another bigger dog stole it from him.
D. His greed made him lose what he already had.

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan: What would most likely have happened if the dog had just ignored the reflection and kept walking?
pilihan_jawaban: A. He would have eaten his delicious bone safely.
B. The "other dog" would have jumped out of the water.
C. He would have found an even bigger bone at home.
D. He would have dropped the bone on the bridge.

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan: Which of the following proverbs best represents the moral value of the story?
pilihan_jawaban: A. A friend in need is a friend indeed.
B. Don't be greedy, or you might lose everything.
C. Time is money.
D. Better late than never.

The following text is for questions number 26 to 29. Honeybees Honeybees are flying insects known for their ability to make honey. A bee colony consists of three types of bees: the queen, workers, and drones. The worker bees are all females and they do all the work for the hive. They fly around to gather nectar from flowers and store it in a special part of their body called the "honey stomach." Drones are male bees, and their only job is to mate with the queen; they do not collect nectar. The queen bee's main task is laying eggs to grow the colony. While worker bees only live for a few weeks during the busy season, a queen bee can live for up to five years.

26. Where do the worker bees keep the nectar after gathering it from flowers?
pilihan_jawaban: A. In the hive
B. In their honey stomach
C. In their wings
D. On their legs

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan: Which one of the following is true based on the text?
pilihan_jawaban: A. The queen bee does all the work for the hive.
B. All worker bees are male.
C. The drones do not collect nectar.
D. Honeybees cannot make their own honey.

pilihan_jawaban: A. The queen bee lives longer than the worker bees.
B. Drones live the longest in the colony.
C. Worker bees only live for five years.
D. The male bees produce the most honey.

D. To retell an experience of being stung by a bee.

The following text is for questions number 37 to 40. Do-It-Yourself: Tie-Dye T-shirt Making your own tie-dye T-shirt is a fun activity that allows you to be creative with colors. Materials: • A plain white cotton T-shirt • Fabric dyes • Rubber bands • A plastic bag • Rubber gloves Steps: 1. Wash the T-shirt but do not dry it. It must be damp before you start. 2. Pinch the center of the shirt and twist it until it forms a flat, circular shape. 3. Wrap rubber bands tightly around the folded shirt to hold its shape. 4. Put on rubber gloves to protect your hands. 5. Squeeze different colors of fabric dye onto different sections of the shirt. 6. Place the dyed shirt into a plastic bag to keep it damp. Let it sit for 24 hours. Do not leave the plastic bag in direct sunlight because it will dry out the shirt too fast. 7. After 24 hours, take the shirt out and remove the rubber bands. 8. Rinse the shirt under cold water until the water runs clear. 9. Dry the T-shirt and it is ready to wear.

37. What is the main purpose of Step 3 (using rubber bands)?
pilihan_jawaban: A. To make the T-shirt look more colorful.
B. To measure how much dye should be added.
C. To hold the folded T-shirt's shape tightly in place.
D. To prevent the water from washing away the dye.

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan: Why should we NOT leave the plastic bag in direct sunlight in Step 6?
pilihan_jawaban: A. Because the plastic bag will melt onto the T- shirt.
B. Because it will dry out the T-shirt too fast.
C. Because the fabric dye will disappear in hot temperatures.
D. Because the T-shirt will turn back into a plain white color.

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan: What is the function of the "rubber gloves" in Step 4?
pilihan_jawaban: A. To be mixed with the fabric dye.
B. To clean the T-shirt before we put the dye.
C. To protect your hands from the fabric dye.
D. To hold the rubber bands while twisting the shirt.

bank_soal.teks_pertanyaan: If you want to make sure the colors absorb perfectly into the fabric and set well, which step is the most important to follow carefully?
pilihan_jawaban: A. Step 8 (Rinsing the shirt under cold water).
B. Step 6 (Letting it sit for 24 hours in a plastic bag).
C. Step 2 (Pinching and twisting the center of the shirt).
D. Step 4 (Putting on rubber gloves).
